history.title: A mountain winery
history.text1: In 2003, Andeluna was born with a clear vision: to create wines that express the altitude, extreme climate and unique conditions of Gualtallary, at over 1,300 meters above sea level.
history.text2: Each vintage is a reflection of the terroir. Minimal intervention in the winery allows the fruit to speak for itself, revealing the freshness, minerality and elegance that only high mountains can offer.

winery.title: The Winery
winery.subtitle: Discover Andeluna: terroir, philosophy, architecture and team.
winery.historyText1: In 2003, the Barale family founded Andeluna with the dream of creating high mountain wines in Gualtallary.
winery.historyText2: Today, with over 20 years of experience, the winery is a benchmark in the Uco Valley.
winery.terroirText: Limestone soils, extreme altitude and mountain climate. A unique terroir that defines the identity of our wines.
winery.philosophyText: We respect the fruit. Every decision in the winery seeks to preserve the pure expression of the terroir.
winery.architectureText: The winery was designed to harness gravity and optimize the winemaking process.
winery.teamText: A passionate team that works with dedication at every stage of the process.
winery.isoText: Certifications that guarantee the quality and sustainability of our wines.

lodgePage.title: Winery Lodge
lodgePage.subtitle: 8 independent lodges where the vineyards extend to the Andes.
lodgePage.aboutText1: Inaugurated in 2023 as part of the winery's 20th anniversary, Andeluna Winery Lodge offers 8 independent lodges of 42–45 m² designed for an exclusive adults-only experience.
lodgePage.aboutText2: Each lodge features a private deck with Andes views, air conditioning, minibar and Wi-Fi. Spa and bicycles are included so you can enjoy the surroundings at your own pace.
lodgePage.ctaText: Experience the complete Andeluna Winery experience sleeping among the vineyards.

wines.title: Our Wines
wines.subtitle: Andeluna wines reflect the soil and land. Each bottle carries our geographic identity: Gualtallary, Tupungato.
wines.introText: At over 1,300 meters above sea level, each grape develops unique concentration and freshness. Our wines express the identity of Gualtallary: minerality, elegance and the unmistakable signature of the Andes.
wines.tastingText: Book a tasting experience and discover Andeluna's complete collection in the heart of the Uco Valley.

pasionado-malbec.philosophy: We honor with passion the soil, the altitude, the Andes and the Moon. The chosen places, discovered for their unique identity, small parcels give these wines personality, sophistication and elegance. This wine represents a poetic way of seeing life.
pasionado-malbec.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
pasionado-malbec.vinification: Hand-harvested at dawn in April, at full phenolic ripeness. Manual berry selection. Pre-fermentative cold maceration. Aged in new French oak barrels (50%), 1st use (25%) and 2nd use (25%) for 12 months, then bottle-aged for a minimum of 8 months.
pasionado-malbec.tastingNotes: Deep color with intense violet hues. Highly complex; aromas of red fruits and flowers, highlighting the typical violets of the variety. On the palate, sophisticated tannins with outstanding personality. Long and extremely pleasant finish.

pasionado-cf.philosophy: A pure expression of Gualtallary Cabernet Franc. This wine represents the elegance and complexity that only high mountains can offer.
pasionado-cf.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
pasionado-cf.vinification: Hand-harvested at dawn. Exhaustive berry selection. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in new French oak barrels for 14 months.
pasionado-cf.tastingNotes: Intense ruby red with purple highlights. Complex nose with ripe red fruit, spices, black pepper and a mineral touch. Elegant on the palate with fine, silky tannins, good acidity and a long, persistent finish.

pasionado-cuatro-cepas.philosophy: Four varieties, one passion. A blend representing the complexity and elegance of Gualtallary.
pasionado-cuatro-cepas.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
pasionado-cuatro-cepas.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented separately by variety. Aged in French oak barrels for 12 months.
pasionado-cuatro-cepas.tastingNotes: Intense red with purple highlights. Complex nose with red fruits, spices and a herbal touch. Elegant on the palate with ripe tannins, good structure and a long finish.

altitud-malbec.philosophy: Pure expression of altitude. A Malbec reflecting the freshness and minerality of Gualtallary.
altitud-malbec.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
altitud-malbec.vinification: Hand-harvested at dawn. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 10 months.
altitud-malbec.tastingNotes: Intense violet-red color. Floral nose with violet, fresh red fruit and mineral notes. Fresh on the palate with elegant tannins, good acidity and a mineral, persistent finish.

altitud-merlot.philosophy: A Merlot defying varietal expectations, with the elegance only high mountains can give.
altitud-merlot.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
altitud-merlot.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 10 months.
altitud-merlot.tastingNotes: Ruby red with purple highlights. Ripe red fruit, plum, chocolate and spiced notes. Silky on the palate with round tannins, good acidity and a pleasant finish.

altitud-cab-sauv.philosophy: The power of high mountain Cabernet Sauvignon. A wine of structure and elegance.
altitud-cab-sauv.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
altitud-cab-sauv.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 12 months.
altitud-cab-sauv.tastingNotes: Intense red with purple highlights. Black fruit, pepper, cassis and herbal notes. Powerful on the palate with ripe tannins, good structure and a long finish.

altitud-pinot.philosophy: A Pinot Noir capturing the delicacy and elegance of high mountains.
altitud-pinot.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
altitud-pinot.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 8 months.
altitud-pinot.tastingNotes: Light ruby red. Delicate nose with raspberry, cherry, floral and earthy notes. Elegant on the palate with fine tannins, good acidity and a fresh finish.

altitud-chardonnay.philosophy: A Chardonnay reflecting the freshness and minerality of Gualtallary.
altitud-chardonnay.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
altitud-chardonnay.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
altitud-chardonnay.tastingNotes: Pale yellow with green highlights. Citrus nose with lemon, grapefruit, tropical fruit and mineral notes. Fresh on the palate with good acidity, citrus notes and a vibrant finish.

altitud-organic-malbec.philosophy: An organic Malbec representing our commitment to sustainability and terroir purity.
altitud-organic-malbec.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl. Certified organic viticulture.
altitud-organic-malbec.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented with native yeasts. Aged in French oak barrels for 10 months.
altitud-organic-malbec.tastingNotes: Intense violet-red color. Floral nose with violet, fresh red fruit and herbal notes. Fresh on the palate with elegant tannins, good acidity and a mineral finish.

altitud-organic-cab-sauv.philosophy: An organic Cabernet Sauvignon combining power and sustainability.
altitud-organic-cab-sauv.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl. Certified organic viticulture.
altitud-organic-cab-sauv.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented with native yeasts. Aged in French oak barrels for 12 months.
altitud-organic-cab-sauv.tastingNotes: Intense red with purple highlights. Black fruit, pepper and herbal notes. Powerful on the palate with ripe tannins, good structure and a long finish.

mil-malbec.philosophy: The iconic wine of the 1300 line. A pure expression of altitude and Gualtallary terroir.
mil-malbec.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-malbec.vinification: Hand-harvested at dawn. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 12 months.
mil-malbec.tastingNotes: Intense red with purple highlights. Ripe red and black fruit, spices and mineral notes. Elegant on the palate with silky tannins, good acidity and a persistent finish.

mil-malbec-magnum.philosophy: The same wine as 1300 Malbec, but in magnum format for slower, more complex evolution.
mil-malbec-magnum.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-malbec-magnum.vinification: Same as 1300 Malbec. Aged in French oak barrels for 12 months.
mil-malbec-magnum.tastingNotes: Same as 1300 Malbec, with more complex evolution thanks to the magnum format.

mil-malbec-375.philosophy: The same wine as 1300 Malbec, in personal format to enjoy alone or as a couple.
mil-malbec-375.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.

mil-cab-sauv.philosophy: A Cabernet Sauvignon reflecting the elegance and power of Gualtallary.
mil-cab-sauv.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-cab-sauv.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 12 months.
mil-cab-sauv.tastingNotes: Intense red. Black fruit, pepper and balsamic notes. Powerful on the palate with ripe tannins, good structure and a long finish.

mil-merlot.philosophy: A Merlot combining softness and character, with high mountain elegance.
mil-merlot.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-merlot.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 10 months.
mil-merlot.tastingNotes: Ruby red. Plum, chocolate, ripe red fruit nose. Silky on the palate with round tannins, good acidity and a pleasant finish.

mil-cab-franc.philosophy: A Cabernet Franc showing the elegance and complexity of the variety at high altitude.
mil-cab-franc.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-cab-franc.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 10 months.
mil-cab-franc.tastingNotes: Ruby red with purple highlights. Aromatic nose with spice, leaf, red fruit notes. Elegant on the palate with fine tannins, good acidity and a persistent finish.

mil-sauv-blanc.philosophy: A Sauvignon Blanc reflecting the freshness and vivacity of high mountains.
mil-sauv-blanc.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-sauv-blanc.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
mil-sauv-blanc.tastingNotes: Pale yellow with green highlights. Citrus nose with lemon, grapefruit, herbs and mineral notes. Fresh on the palate with good acidity, citrus notes and a vibrant finish.

mil-chardonnay.philosophy: A Chardonnay combining mountain freshness with barrel creaminess.
mil-chardonnay.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-chardonnay.vinification: Hand-harvested. Partial fermentation in French oak barrels. Sur lie aging for 6 months.
mil-chardonnay.tastingNotes: Golden yellow. Ripe fruit, butter, vanilla and barrel notes nose. Creamy on the palate with good acidity, fruit notes and an elegant finish.

mil-torrontes.philosophy: A Torrontés representing the Uco Valley's signature varietal.
mil-torrontes.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-torrontes.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
mil-torrontes.tastingNotes: Pale yellow. Floral and exotic nose with rose, lychee, tropical fruit and mineral notes. Fresh on the palate with good acidity, floral notes and an elegant finish.

mil-torrontes-dulce.philosophy: A natural sweet wine combining Torrontés exoticism with high mountain freshness.
mil-torrontes-dulce.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
mil-torrontes-dulce.vinification: Hand-harvested. Interrupted fermentation to preserve residual sugar. No oak aging.
mil-torrontes-dulce.tastingNotes: Golden yellow. Tropical fruit, honey, floral nose. Sweet but balanced on the palate, with good acidity compensating the sweetness and a fresh finish.

raices-malbec.philosophy: A Malbec honoring the roots and winemaking tradition of Mendoza.
raices-malbec.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
raices-malbec.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 8 months.
raices-malbec.tastingNotes: Intense red. Ripe red fruit, spices, earthy notes nose. Direct on the palate with ripe tannins, good acidity and an honest, varietal finish.

raices-cab-sauv.philosophy: A Cabernet Sauvignon expressing the authenticity of Gualtallary terroir.
raices-cab-sauv.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
raices-cab-sauv.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in French oak barrels for 8 months.
raices-cab-sauv.tastingNotes: Intense red. Black fruit, pepper, herbal notes nose. Direct on the palate with ripe tannins, good structure and a varietal finish.

raices-chardonnay.philosophy: A Chardonnay showing the minerality and tension of high mountains.
raices-chardonnay.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
raices-chardonnay.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
raices-chardonnay.tastingNotes: Pale yellow. Citrus, mineral nose with lemon and wet stone notes. Tense on the palate with good acidity, minerality and a fresh, persistent finish.

emblema.philosophy: Andeluna's most representative wine. A blend combining the best of each variety in a unique, elegant expression.
emblema.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
emblema.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented separately by variety. Aged in new French oak barrels for 18 months.
emblema.tastingNotes: Intense red with purple highlights. Complex nose with black fruit, spices, violet, balsamic notes. Elegant on the palate with fine, silky tannins, good structure, vibrant acidity and a long, persistent finish.

francs.philosophy: The purest expression of Gualtallary Cabernet Franc. A single-vineyard wine, unique and unrepeatable.
francs.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. Specific vineyard plot at over 1,300 masl.
francs.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. Aged in new French oak barrels for 16 months.
francs.tastingNotes: Intense ruby red. Complex nose with red fruit, spices, pepper, violet, mineral notes. Elegant on the palate with fine, silky tannins, vibrant acidity, minerality and a long, persistent finish.

blanc-de-franc.philosophy: A limited edition showing the versatility of Cabernet Franc vinified as white.
blanc-de-franc.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
blanc-de-franc.vinification: Hand-harvested. Gentle pressing. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
blanc-de-franc.tastingNotes: Pale yellow with golden highlights. Citrus, mineral nose with lemon, grapefruit and wet stone notes. Fresh on the palate, tense, with good acidity and a mineral, elegant finish.

torrontes.philosophy: A Torrontés representing Argentina's most emblematic varietal signature.
torrontes.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
torrontes.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
torrontes.tastingNotes: Pale yellow. Floral and exotic nose with rose, jasmine, lychee, tropical fruit. Fresh on the palate with good acidity, floral notes and an elegant finish.

rose.philosophy: An author rosé combining freshness and elegance.
rose.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
rose.vinification: Hand-harvested. Gentle pressing. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
rose.tastingNotes: Pale pink with golden highlights. Fresh red fruit, floral, citrus nose. Fresh on the palate, light, with good acidity and a pleasant finish.

extra-brut.philosophy: A natural sparkling combining mountain freshness with fine bubble elegance.
extra-brut.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
extra-brut.vinification: Traditional method. Secondary fermentation in bottle. Minimum 18 months sur lie aging.
extra-brut.tastingNotes: Pale yellow with fine, persistent bubbles. White fruit, toasted, fresh-baked bread nose. Fresh on the palate, elegant, with good acidity and a long finish.

ensamble-otonal.philosophy: A blend capturing the warmth and richness of autumn in Mendoza.
ensamble-otonal.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
ensamble-otonal.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented separately by variety. Aged in French oak barrels for 10 months.
ensamble-otonal.tastingNotes: Intense red with purple highlights. Ripe red and black fruit, spices, balsamic notes nose. Generous on the palate with ripe tannins, good acidity and a warm, pleasant finish.

blanc-de-malbec.philosophy: An Andeluna exclusive: red grape vinified as white. A unique and surprising wine.
blanc-de-malbec.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
blanc-de-malbec.vinification: Hand-harvested. Gentle, rapid pressing to avoid skin contact. Fermented in stainless steel tanks.
blanc-de-malbec.tastingNotes: Pale yellow with golden highlights. White fruit, floral, exotic nose. Fresh on the palate, elegant, with good acidity and a mineral, persistent finish.

wine-not.philosophy: Andeluna's most fun label. A young Malbec to enjoy without formality.
wine-not.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
wine-not.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
wine-not.tastingNotes: Intense violet-red. Fresh, juicy red fruit, floral nose. Fresh on the palate, fruity, direct, with soft tannins and a pleasant, fun finish.

semillon.philosophy: A Sémillon showing the elegance and freshness of the variety at high altitude.
semillon.vineyard: Gualtallary, Tupungato, Mendoza. At over 1,300 masl.
semillon.vinification: Hand-harvested. Fermented in stainless steel tanks. No oak aging.
semillon.tastingNotes: Pale yellow with green highlights. Citrus nose with lemon, herbs, mineral notes. Fresh on the palate, tense, with good acidity and a mineral, elegant finish.
